name: Brisure Capital

A reversible scroll scene advances through seven years, synchronizing growing contours, a rolling year, captions, and illustrative lending readouts.

Digit-roll facts and office clocks support the quieter information sections.

decisions.title: Make time tangible
decisions.body: The red full stop becomes a company point. As the visitor scrolls, contour rings grow around it while the year and illustrative lending figures advance together.

decisions.title: Keep the details close
decisions.body: Strategy bars reveal image plates on desktop and open as touch accordions. The same spare grid carries the quieter facilities, facts and contact information.
